translations.web: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.
translations.bsb: I wish that all men were as I am. But each man has his own gift from God; one has this gift, another has that.
translations.kjv: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.
translations.asv: Yet I would that all men were even as I myself. Howbeit each man hath his own gift from God, one after this manner, and another after that.
